subject: INTEGER-PART function
notes: §15.49.4 r1's EAE (SIGN(a) * INTEGER(ABS(a))) over seven arguments, reaching the |a| < 1 branch where the SIGN factor multiplies a ZERO (a=-0.5 and a=-0.25 return 0 while INTEGER of the same argument returns -1 — §15.44.4's own 'similar but returns different values for negative numbers'). The 2023 golden declares ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL, so §15.4.1 r1 makes equality mandatory and it is the NORMATIVE pin; the 85 golden covers the row's 85 edition leg as a DETERMINATION pin against docs/CONFORMANCE.md A.1 item 92 ('INTEGER floors and INTEGER-PART truncates'), which is the same §15.4.1 native-arithmetic determination the pre-existing pb2_float_argument_exact_family already measures.
